notes: Measurements are sent as integers that must be multiplied by the transformer ratios read from the device (CTRF at 4096, VTRFwM at 4095); the descriptions give the formula when the manufacturer table prints it.
Converted from the ModbusHub transcription of the manufacturer table. Not verified on a device.
The manufacturer table has no unit column: units are taken from the register names.
